allow: PowerShell(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceAlias -match 'Wi-Fi|Ethernet' } | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(@\("192.168.0.1","192.168.0.14","192.168.0.135"\) | ForEach-Object { $ip = $_; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://${ip}/status" -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "$ip -> $\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Host "$ip -> no response" } })

PowerShell(1..254 | ForEach-Object -Parallel { $ip = "192.168.0.$_"; try { $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $result = $tcp.BeginConnect\($ip, 80, $null, $null\); $wait = $result.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne\(200\); if \($wait -and $tcp.Connected\) { Write-Output "$ip :80 OPEN" }; $tcp.Close\(\) } catch {} } -ThrottleLimit 50)

PowerShell(@\("192.168.0.80","192.168.0.96"\) | ForEach-Object { $ip = $_; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://${ip}/status" -TimeoutSec 3 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "$ip -> $\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Host "$ip -> no /status \($\($_.Exception.Message\)\)" } })
